#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Backup destination: a directory (local, NFS, or other mounted filesystem)
# or a remote "user@host:path" for scp. Required: set BACKUP_DEST, this
# script, or pass it as the first argument.
DEST="${1:-${BACKUP_DEST:-${BACKUP_DST:-}}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup: no destination configured" >&2
    echo "backup: set BACKUP_DEST, pass it as \$1, or edit DEST in backup.sh" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup: logs/ directory not found; nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *"*"*)
        echo "backup: refusing destination '$DEST' (contains shell metacharacters)" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if case "$DEST" in *"@*"*) true ;; *) false ;; esac && case "$DEST" in *":"*) true ;; *) false ;; esac; then
    # remote host:path -- split at the last colon
    DEST_HOST="${DEST%:*}"
    DEST_PATH="${DEST#*:}"
    mkdir -p -- "$DEST_HOST:$DEST_PATH" 2>/dev/null # no-op on remote; local check below
    scp -q -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
else
    # local directory (or mount)
    mkdir -p -- "$DEST"
    cp -f -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
fi

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then

fi

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup: logs/ directory not found; nothing to back up" >&2

case "$DEST" in
    *"*"*)
        echo "backup: refusing destination '$DEST' (contains shell metacharacters)" >&2

if printf '%s\n' "$DEST" | grep -Eq '^[^:/]+@[^:/]+:'; then

#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# Backup destination: a local directory (local, NFS, or any mounted
# filesystem) or a remote "user@host:path" for scp. Supply it as the first
# argument, via the BACKUP_DEST environment variable, or edit DEST below.
DEST="${1:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}"

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup: no destination configured" >&2
    echo "backup: set BACKUP_DEST, pass it as \$1, or edit DEST in backup.sh" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d logs ]; then
    echo "backup: logs/ directory not found; nothing to back up" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Create today's tarball
tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Reject anything that looks shell-special (spaces, quotes, $, etc.).
# Remote destinations are allowed because scp takes one argv entry.
case "$DEST" in
    *" "*|*'"'*|*"'"'*|*"${"*|*"`"*|*"*"*|*"("|*")"*|*"|"*|*"&"*|*";"*|*">"*|*"<"*|*"#"*)
        echo "backup: refusing destination '$DEST' (contains shell metacharacters)" >&2
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

if printf '%s\n' "$DEST" | grep -Eq '^[^:/]+@[^:/]+:'; then
    # Remote "user@host:path" -- copy with scp
    scp -q -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
else
    # Local directory (or mount)
    mkdir -p -- "$DEST"
    cp -f -- "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
fi

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
